tasks.instruction: Aşağıdaki kütüphane çalışma odası rezervasyon duyurusunu okuyup soruları yanıtlayın.
tasks.material_title: Campus Library: Group Study Room Policy Update
tasks.material_text: Starting next Monday, students may reserve group study rooms up to 72 hours in advance via the university portal. A minimum of three registered students is required to maintain a booking. If a group fails to check in within 15 minutes of their scheduled time, the reservation will be automatically cancelled and made available to walk-in groups. Individual study is strictly prohibited in these rooms.

questions.question: What is the earliest a group can book a study room?
options: 15 minutes before the session starts
24 hours prior to use
72 hours in advance
One week before next Monday
questions.explanation_tr: Metinde 'students may reserve group study rooms up to 72 hours in advance' (72 saat öncesine kadar) ifadesi açıkça belirtilmiştir.

questions.question: What happens if a reserved group arrives 20 minutes late?
options: They receive an academic penalty fee.
Their booking is forfeited and offered to other students.
They must present individual student IDs at the circulation desk.
The room remains locked until the next hour.
questions.explanation_tr: 15 dakika içinde giriş (check-in) yapılmazsa rezervasyon otomatik iptal edilir ve bekleyen diğer öğrencilere açılır ('automatically cancelled and made available to walk-in groups').

tasks.title: Task 3: Read an Academic Passage
tasks.instruction: Güneş enerjisi teknolojisine dair kısa akademik pasajı okuyup soruları cevaplayın.
tasks.passage_text: Modern photovoltaic (PV) cells convert solar radiation into electricity through the photovoltaic effect. While silicon-based cells achieve commercial efficiencies around 22 percent, operational longevity remains constrained by thermal degradation. Sustained exposure to high operating temperatures accelerates material fatigue in cell junctions. Consequently, material scientists are developing perovskite-silicon tandem configurations that optimize absorption across the broader solar spectrum while mitigating heat-induced efficiency losses.

questions.question: The word 'constrained' in the passage is closest in meaning to:
options: enhanced
limited
measured
accelerated
questions.explanation_tr: 'Constrained' kısıtlanmış, sınırlandırılmış anlamına gelir; bu bağlamda en yakın karşılığı 'limited'dır.

questions.question: According to the passage, why are scientists researching perovskite-silicon tandem cells?
options: To replace solar power with thermal geothermal heating
To eliminate the need for silicon-based semiconductor materials entirely
To broaden light absorption while reducing heat-related performance decline
To lower commercial manufacturing costs below traditional fossil fuel plants
questions.explanation_tr: Metnin son cümlesinde tandem yapıların 'optimize absorption across the broader solar spectrum while mitigating heat-induced efficiency losses' (spektrumu genişletip ısı kaynaklı kayıpları azaltma) amacıyla geliştirildiği ifade edilmiştir.

tasks.title: Task 3: Academic Talk (Marine Biology)
tasks.context: A marine biology professor delivers a short lecture on coral bleaching mechanisms.
tasks.audio_text: Coral bleaching is often misunderstood as the immediate death of coral colonies. In reality, it represents a breakdown in the symbiotic partnership between the coral host and microscopic algae known as zooxanthellae. When ocean temperatures rise by merely one or two degrees Celsius above seasonal maximums, the algae produce toxic reactive oxygen species. To protect itself, the coral polyp expels the algae, losing its vibrant pigmentation and primary nutrient source. If elevated thermal stress persists for several weeks, the coral starves; however, if temperatures normalize promptly, corals can reacquire algae and fully recover.

questions.question: What is the primary cause of coral bleaching explained in the lecture?
options: Predation by invasive deep-sea species
The coral polyp expelling its symbiotic algae due to elevated water temperatures
Mechanical damage caused by commercial marine shipping
A permanent genetic mutation occurring in cold ocean waters
questions.explanation_tr: Metinde mercan ağarmasının ana sebebinin artan sıcaklık sonucu polipin algleri dışarı atması ('coral polyp expels the algae') olduğu anlatılır.

questions.question: What happens if water temperatures return to normal relatively quickly?
options: The coral permanently fossilizes into limestone.
The coral can reacquire algae and recover.
The algae become toxic to surrounding fish populations.
The colony must be relocated by researchers.
questions.explanation_tr: Son cümlede 'if temperatures normalize promptly, corals can reacquire algae and fully recover' (hızla normale dönerse iyileşebilir) denmektedir.

tasks.title: Task 2: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Aşağıdaki senaryoyu okuyup 3 hedef maddeyi eksiksiz içeren 80-120 kelimelik bir e-posta yazın.
tasks.scenario: You are living in a university dormitory, and the Wi-Fi connection on your floor has been intermittent for three days, interfering with your online exam preparations.
bullets: Sorunu ve kaç gündür devam ettiğini net açıklayın (Describe the problem and duration).
Bu arızanın akademik çalışmalarınızı nasıl etkilediğini belirtin (Explain how it impacts your study).
Teknik inceleme veya geçici çözüm talep edin (Request a technician visit or alternative access).
tasks.sample_solution:
Dear IT Support Team,

I am writing to report a persistent internet connectivity issue on the fourth floor of West Hall dormitory. For the past three days, the Wi-Fi signal has been repeatedly dropping every few minutes.

This disruption is severely affecting my academic coursework, as I am currently preparing for upcoming midterm examinations and need continuous access to lecture recordings and online research databases.

Could you please dispatch a technician to inspect the floor router as soon as possible, or provide temporary access to an alternative network? Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

tasks.title: Task 3: Write for an Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction: Profesörün sorusunu ve öğrencilerin görüşlerini okuyup en az 100 kelimelik akademik bir katkı sunun.
tasks.professor_question: Should municipal governments allocate major transportation funds toward expanding bicycle lanes and pedestrian paths, or toward upgrading public subway and bus transit? Share your reasoned opinion.

student_a.name: Lena
student_a.text: Investing in bike lanes promotes personal health and drastically reduces short-distance carbon emissions at a relatively low construction cost.

student_b.name: David
student_b.text: Subways and buses are far more essential because they support high-capacity commutes across long distances, regardless of harsh weather.

tasks.sample_solution: In this debate, I firmly align with David's perspective that upgrading public subway and bus transit delivers superior long-term socio-economic benefits. While Lena makes a valid point regarding the health advantages and low installation costs of bicycle lanes, cycling is fundamentally limited by extreme weather conditions and long suburban commute distances. In contrast, a modern, reliable public transit network serves thousands of daily commuters simultaneously, reducing highway congestion and ensuring equitable mobility for low-income residents who cannot bike long distances. For instance, expanding rapid transit lines encourages workers to leave their cars at home, thereby cutting greenhouse gas emissions on a much larger scale. Consequently, public transit upgrades should remain the primary municipal priority.

tasks.title: Task 3: Read an Academic Passage
tasks.instruction: Antik ticaret ağları hakkındaki akademik metni okuyup soruları cevaplayın.
tasks.passage_title: Cross-Cultural Diffusion Along Ancient Maritime Routes
tasks.passage_text: Ancient Indian Ocean trade routes facilitated not only the exchange of physical commodities like spices and ceramics, but also the profound diffusion of architectural and linguistic conventions. Coastal port settlements evolved into cosmopolitan enclaves where merchant guilds negotiated commercial agreements across diverse cultural boundaries. Archaeological findings of hybrid pottery motifs demonstrate that local artisans actively synthesized foreign aesthetics rather than merely imitating imported prototypes.

questions.question: The word 'diffusion' in the passage is closest in meaning to:

spread
interruption
taxation
questions.explanation_tr: 'Diffusion' yayılma, dağılma anlamındadır ve en yakın eşanlamlısı 'spread'dir.

questions.question: What do the archaeological findings of hybrid pottery motifs suggest?
options: Local craftsmen developed entirely independent techniques without foreign influence.
Imported ceramics were deemed inferior to indigenous pottery.
Artisans creatively combined foreign styles with local traditions.
Maritime trade was restricted solely to raw mineral shipments.
questions.explanation_tr: 'Artisans actively synthesized foreign aesthetics' ifadesi, yerel zanaatkârların yabancı stilleri yerel geleneklerle yaratıcı biçimde birleştirdiğini gösterir.

tasks.title: Task 3: Academic Talk (Behavioral Economics)
tasks.context: An economics professor explains the concept of 'loss aversion'.
tasks.audio_text: In neoclassical economics, individuals were assumed to evaluate gains and losses symmetrically. However, behavioral experiments pioneered by Kahneman and Tversky demonstrate that human decision-making exhibits profound loss aversion. Psychologically, the pain of losing one hundred dollars is felt roughly twice as intensely as the joy of gaining the exact same amount. This cognitive bias explains why investors often hold onto plummeting stocks too long in hopes of breaking even, or why consumers are disproportionately reluctant to give up trial subscriptions.

questions.question: What is the core premise of loss aversion as described in the talk?
options: Gains and losses produce identical psychological reactions.
The psychological pain of a loss is significantly greater than the pleasure of an equivalent gain.
Financial markets always behave in a perfectly rational manner.
Consumers prefer losing money over taking financial risks.
questions.explanation_tr: Kayıptan kaçınma kuramı, bir kaybın acısının aynı miktardaki kazancın hazzından yaklaşık iki kat daha yoğun hissedildiğini ('roughly twice as intensely') belirtir.

questions.question: What real-world example of loss aversion does the professor mention?
options: Government treasury bond auctions
Investors holding declining assets too long to avoid realizing a loss
Corporate mergers in the telecommunications sector
International currency exchange fluctuations
questions.explanation_tr: Metinde yatırımcıların zararı kabullenmemek için düşen hisseleri çok uzun süre ellerinde tutmaları örneği verilir.

tasks.title: Task 3: Write for an Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction: Profesörün sorusunu ve öğrencilerin görüşlerini okuyup en az 100 kelimelik akademik bir katkı sunun.
tasks.professor_question: Should universities permit students to use generative AI writing tools for drafting and brainstorming coursework, provided they formally disclose how the tool was utilized? Share your perspective.

student_a.name: Hana
student_a.text: Generative AI is an inevitable workplace tool. Universities should teach students responsible prompting and critical evaluation rather than imposing ineffective bans.

student_b.name: Mateo
student_b.text: Allowing AI undermines genuine critical thinking and makes it impossible for educators to assess authentic student writing and analytical reasoning.

tasks.sample_solution: I strongly concur with Hana's perspective that universities should embrace generative AI as an educational tool accompanied by strict transparency guidelines. While Mateo raises a legitimate concern regarding academic integrity and the preservation of authentic analytical skills, outright bans are both impractical to enforce and counterproductive in preparing students for contemporary careers. In today's digital economy, artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming ubiquitous across professional industries; therefore, higher education institutions must equip students with the skills to prompt effectively, cross-verify automated outputs, and refine AI-assisted drafts critically. For instance, requiring students to submit an appendix detailing how AI contributed to their research process fosters honesty while developing technological literacy. By teaching ethical utilization, universities cultivate responsible scholarship without compromising academic rigor.

tasks.instruction: Ötegezegen araştırmaları hakkındaki akademik metni okuyup soruları yanıtlayın.
tasks.passage_text: The detection of exoplanetary atmospheres relies heavily on transmission spectroscopy, a technique measuring the subtle dimming of starlight as a planet transits its host star. When starlight filters through the planetary atmosphere, specific chemical compounds absorb characteristic wavelengths, leaving spectroscopic fingerprints. Identifying biosignature gases such as methane in conjunction with oxygen remains challenging because non-biological geological processes can occasionally mimic atmospheric disequilibria.

questions.question: The word 'subtle' in the passage is closest in meaning to:
options: slight
destructive
sudden

questions.explanation_tr: 'Subtle' hafif, ince, göze çarpmayan anlamındadır; en yakın karşılığı 'slight'tır.

Non-biological geological phenomena can produce gas signatures resembling life.
Planets in the habitable zone never transit their parent stars.
Atmospheric temperatures instantly degrade all chemical compounds.
questions.explanation_tr: Metinde biyolojik olmayan jeolojik süreçlerin de benzer gaz dengesizlikleri üretebildiği ('non-biological geological processes can occasionally mimic...') vurgulanmıştır.

tasks.title: Task 3: Academic Talk (Architectural Acoustics)
tasks.context: An architecture professor lectures on reverberation time in concert hall design.
tasks.audio_text: Reverberation time, denoted as RT60, is defined as the time required for sound energy in an enclosed space to decay by sixty decibels. In symphonic concert halls, an optimal reverberation time between 1.8 and 2.2 seconds creates warmth and acoustic blend. However, for spaces intended primarily for speech, such as lecture halls and drama theaters, a much shorter reverberation time of under one second is essential to prevent reflected sound from smearing consonants and compromising verbal intelligibility.

questions.question: What is the primary function of a short reverberation time in lecture halls?
options: To amplify bass musical frequencies
To ensure speech clarity and verbal intelligibility
To eliminate the need for sound-absorbing wall insulation
To reflect sound equally into adjacent corridors

tasks.scenario: You are writing a senior research thesis and need access to an out-of-print historical manuscript held in the university's special collections archive.
bullets: Tez konunuzu ve ilgili kaynağı belirtin (Mention your thesis topic and the specific manuscript).
Arşiv odasında inceleme yapmak için randevu talep edin (Request a supervised viewing appointment).

tasks.sample_solution:
Dear Special Collections Librarian,

I am currently working on my senior history thesis focusing on nineteenth-century municipal water infrastructure. I am writing to request access to the out-of-print archival manuscript titled 'City Waterworks Records (1882)' held in your special collections department.

Could I schedule an appointment next Tuesday afternoon to examine this volume in the reading room? Furthermore, could you please let me know whether non-flash photography is permitted for taking reference notes from these archival pages?

Thank you very much for your time and assistance.

Sincerely,
Elena Rostova

tasks.title: Task 3: Write for an Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction: Profesörün sorusunu ve öğrencilerin görüşlerini okuyup en az 100 kelimelik akademik bir katkı sunun.
tasks.professor_question: If a university receives a substantial unrestricted financial endowment, should it prioritize expanding quiet individual study spaces or modern recreational lounges? State and defend your choice.

student_a.name: Leah
student_a.text: Expanding quiet study rooms is essential because deep concentration is the primary foundation for academic success, especially during exam periods.

student_b.name: Omar
student_b.text: Recreational lounges should take priority because student mental health and community bonding are just as crucial for overall university retention.

tasks.sample_solution: While Omar raises a compelling argument regarding the vital role of mental wellness and peer interaction on campus, I firmly endorse Leah's view that investing in quiet individual study spaces is the more prudent allocation of university funds. An academic institution's primary purpose is to cultivate scholarship and intellectual rigor, which require environments free from noise and distractions. With rising enrollment, students frequently struggle to find tranquil workspaces in overcrowded campus libraries, impairing their ability to engage in deep reading and complex problem-solving. For instance, universities that provide dedicated silent cubicles and reservable study carrels report higher student satisfaction during midterm and final exam weeks. While recreational spaces are beneficial, off-campus cafes and dormitories already offer social venues, making quiet, academically focused facilities a far more unique and indispensable campus asset.
